dependencies.purpose: Provide persona, voice identity, voice resolution, and synthesis capabilities without transferring ownership to Palaver.

target_dependencies.purpose: Provide provider-neutral AI inference, model selection, provider routing, fallback, and usage lineage.
Perform authorized durable filesystem mutations and controlled execution.
Provide authoritative task discovery, priority, readiness, blockers, and continuation state.

invariants: Only verified active relationships appear in dependencies.
Target dependencies are migration requirements and are not evidence of completed integration.
Palaver owns conversation and interaction mediation.
Envoy retains ownership of persona and voice identity.
Opus retains ownership of AI provider and model orchestration.
Coda retains ownership of canonical durable mutation.
Niche retains ownership of task governance.
Failure of optional voice capability must not disable text conversation.
